title: Implement dependency-aware StepScheduler
purpose: Schedule plan steps deterministically according to dependencies, risk gates, retry budget, and observation requirements.
scope: Implement ready-step selection for a PlanRun DAG.
Reject cycles and missing dependencies at plan validation time.
Support sequential execution first; document where safe read-only parallelism can be added later.
Respect retry budgets and fail closed on repeated verification failure.
Produce scheduler explanations for TUI and audit summaries.
Ensure a skipped or denied dependency blocks dependent steps unless the plan explicitly marks an alternative path.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduler returns only steps whose dependencies are sealed or explicitly satisfied.
Dependent steps do not run after denied prerequisite steps.
Retry budget exhaustion moves the run to Suspended or FailedClosed.
Scheduler output is deterministic for the same PlanRun.
verification: Test linear, branched, cyclic, denied-dependency, and retry-exhausted plans.
risk_notes: Hidden scheduler nondeterminism makes audit and recovery hard to reason about.
